synth_user: When a skill block is in my latest message, what do I do?
synth_content: I will treat the skill block in my latest message as the active instruction and ignore earlier questions. I will use the argument after the block as the current argument, not an example from inside the skill. If there is no argument, I will use the skill's required default wording. I will reply text only with the exact required confirmation: skill name, current argument or default wording, and required wording. I will not call tools.
